caveat: This registry curates historical landslide outcomes for Professional Mitigation Intelligence. Unknown values remain null; current ISPRA PAI signatures are not treated as historical-at-collapse evidence.

Camera dei Deputati - XVII Legislatura, seduta 244

evidence_references.described_source: Court-appointed geotechnical and technical expert reports in the Sciacca proceedings
supports: scour and erosion of granular support at pier foundations
hydraulic rather than landslide outcome classification

limitations: The user-provided summary attributes the collapse to hydraulic scour and erosion at pier foundations, so the event must not enter a landslide cohort.

The underlying court-appointed reports have not been attached or independently reviewed by ARCUS; their exact wording, measurements and attribution strength remain pending primary-document verification.

The cross-hazard correction is integrated into the Professional Hydraulic cohort as probable evidence with weight 0.5; the unavailable primary reports are not represented as directly reviewed evidence.

cases.bridge_name: Ponte Emilio Barsanti at Albiano Magra

supports: absence of an official landslide attribution in the registered notice
evidence_references.title: MIT - Crollo ponte: istituzione della Commissione ispettiva

supports: published collapse survey classification requiring reconciliation
evidence_references.title: Bridge collapses in Italy across the 21st century: survey and statistical analysis

supports: court-appointed experts reported slow ground displacement associated with an old active landslide
evidence_references.title: Il Tirreno - Albiano Magra first-instance judgement and court-expert findings

evidence_references.described_source: Court-appointed technical report / incidente probatorio filed at the Tribunal of Massa
supports: thrust from an ancient paleolandslide on the east abutment
historical bridge widening without adequate pier strengthening
multicausal interaction between ground movement, structural works and management deficiencies

limitations: The user-provided CTU summary supports a landslide contribution, but the full report has not been attached or independently reviewed by ARCUS.
The collapse is explicitly multicausal: paleolandslide thrust, structural modifications and historical management or surveillance factors must not be collapsed into a pure-landslide label.
The case can inform a future multicausal interaction model, but is excluded from the current pure-landslide learning cohort.
Exact CTU wording, quantitative ground displacement and any subsequent judicial findings remain to be verified from primary documents.

limitations: Official records document a wide landslide below the road at the same coordinates in May 2023 and a linked bridge-collapse intervention in 2024, but not the direct bridge-landslide interaction mechanism.
The 2024 inventory date and the ARCUS event date cannot be reconciled from the available evidence.
The disposition is closed as excluded; it may be reopened only if a source directly documents the interaction mechanism and resolves the chronology.

eligibility_contract.rule: A case is eligible only when the collapse and landslide interaction are source-backed, all minimum fields are populated, an independent episode_id is assigned, and the outcome is a confirmed landslide collapse rather than a cross-hazard reclassification or an explicitly multicausal case.

engineering_basis.document: Valutazione della classe di attenzione associata al rischio frane e manuale operativo a supporto del Livello 3
principles_retained: separate territorial and local susceptibility from bridge-landslide interaction
do not infer Level 2 or Level 3 attention class from current PAI class alone
consider movement severity and velocity, interaction geometry, affected component and foundation context
require site-specific professional assessment before monitoring or mitigation prescriptions

production_support_contract.note: These conservative thresholds are an abstention barrier, not a validated landslide strategy-activation rule. They require expert engineering and statistical review before any production strategy can be enabled.
